assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one print-ready original landscape poster texture for a student's 3D bedroom wall. Hand-painted shapes, textured gouache, expressive inky contour lines, deliberate crosshatching in shadows, subtle halftone print grain and tiny off-register cyan/red accents. Cinematic animated-film visual development quality with believable architectural perspective. Navy ink, dusky turquoise, cream, warm orange window lights, small magenta accents. Flat edge-to-edge artwork on a rectangular 3:2 canvas, straight-on, no physical frame, no wall, no room, no mockup, no margins. No text, logos, signatures or watermarks. The art must be legible at small size but rewarding in close-up, with human drawing character rather than neat geometric bars.
